name: New York

filing.name: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations

revenue.name: New York Department of Taxation and Finance

labor.name: New York State Department of Labor

llcReport.title: File Biennial Statement
llcReport.deadline: During the anniversary month every 2 years

corpReport.title: File Biennial Statement
corpReport.deadline: During the anniversary month every 2 years

llpReport.title: File LLP statement
llpReport.deadline: Within the 60 days before the fifth anniversary of registration, then every five years

llcPublication: New York LLCs must publish their articles of organization or a notice of formation in two newspapers within 120 days, then file a Certificate of Publication with the Division of Corporations ($50) or lose authority to do business.
entityTax: Corporate franchise tax (fixed-dollar minimum, MTA surcharge); LLC filing fee; optional Pass-Through Entity Tax

penalty.note: 10% of the tax for the first month plus 1% for each additional month, up to 30%, with a $50 minimum.

unemployment.note: Greater of $1,000 or $50 times the employees on the last quarterly return, up to $10,000 a quarter, for a late or incomplete NYS-45.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: $2,000 for every 10 days out of compliance (Workers' Compensation Board).

paidLeave.title: NY Disability Benefits and Paid Family Leave coverage
paidLeave.description: Employers must carry DBL and PFL coverage (typically through an insurer).

paidSickLeave.note: New York requires up to 56 hours of paid sick leave from employers with 100 or more employees and up to 40 hours of paid leave from those with 5 to 99; employers with 4 or fewer employees provide up to 40 hours, unpaid, or paid if net income was over $1 million.

local.title: City licenses
local.description: New York has no general business license; NYC and other cities license specific industries.

industry.health: New York State Department of Health
